statement: Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure guidance to $195-$205 billion from $180-$190 billion, its second upward revision this year, and reaffirmed plans for another significant increase in 2027.
why: Hyperscaler capex guidance is the most direct read on how many accelerators and how much data-center capacity will be bought; a second consecutive raise with an explicit demand-outpaces-investment rationale signals continuing order flow to GPU and infrastructure vendors.

impact.mechanism: A raised capex range plus a stated plan for another significant increase in 2027 converts into accelerator, networking, data-center and power purchase orders across the build-out chain.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (Bloomberg wire) — "Google increases capex forecast again after cloud-driven earnings beat"
evidence.excerpt: Alphabet raised its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $195-$205 billion, up from the previous $180-$190 billion guidance announced last quarter.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (Bloomberg wire) — "Google increases capex forecast again after cloud-driven earnings beat"
evidence.excerpt: We have increased our capacity quite significantly over the past three years. The demand still outpaces that investment.

confidence.basis: Single secondary wire report of an earnings release rather than the filing itself; figures are specific and quoted, but with one publisher fetched confidence is capped at medium.
